probe.why: MCP capability advertised in initialize (prompts.listChanged=true). Slash-command-style prompts the agent can invoke. Validates the server responds with a structured prompts[] array.

prompts.name: plan_workflow_execution
prompts.description: Plan whether to use browser traversal or explicit replay for an indexed/published workflow contract, using its prerequisites, typed params, and dependency graph.

arguments.name: endpoint_id
arguments.description: Optional endpoint id. Defaults to the preferred recipe.

arguments.name: intent
arguments.description: Optional user goal or task phrasing.

arguments.name: user_goal
arguments.description: Optional alternate wording for the goal.

prompts.name: workflow:resolve-execute-feedback
prompts.description: Cached-intent playbook: resolve → pick → execute → feedback. Use for any 'find X on site Y' task when the site has prior coverage.

prompts.name: workflow:browse-and-publish
prompts.description: Cold-intent playbook: open a browse session, capture the user's answer, then close + review + publish before responding. Required on first-visit to a new domain.
